title: DART-seq
protocol: Wash and prepare beads according to manufacturer’s protocol.
Design single-stranded DNA custom primer sequences complementary to regions of interest with a 5’ phosphate modification added.
Design complementary splint sequences that carry an 8-12 bp overhang of A-repeats.
Resuspend all oligos in Tris-EDTA buffer at a concentration of 500 μM.
Mix equal volumes (20 μL) of the custom primer and splint oligos in the presence of 50 mM NaCl.
Heat the reaction mixture to 95 °C and cool to 14 °C at -0.1 °C/s.
Dilute each toehold probe with TE buffer to obtain a final concentration of 100 μM.
Mix toehold probes in desired ratio and dilute the mixture to obtain the desired final probe concentration.
Combine 16 μL of this pooled probe mixture with 40 μL of PEG-4000 (50% w/v), 40 μL of T4 DNA ligase buffer, 72 μL of water, and 2 μL of T4 DNA Ligase.
Combine 12,000 beads with the ligation mix and incubate for 1 hour at 37 °C (with 15 second alternative mixing at 1800 rpm).
Inactivate enzyme by heating the reaction mix at 65 °C for 3 minutes.
Quench reaction mixture by placing in ice water for at least 1 minute.
Perform 6-10 bead ligation reactions in parallel to obtain the desired quantity of DART-seq primer beads.
Pool all bead ligation reactions and wash beads once with 250 μL Tris-EDTA Sodium dodecyl sulfate (TE-SDS) buffer.
Wash beads twice with Tris-EDTA-Tween 20 (TE-TW) buffer.
Store DART-seq primer beads in TE-TW at 4 °C if moving ahead to microfluidics setup.

Resuspend count beads using Fuchs-Rosenthal hemocytometer in lysis buffer consisting of 500μL water, 300μL of 20% Ficoll PM 400, 10μL Sarkosyl, 40μL of 0.5M EDTA, 100μL of 2M tris pH 7.5, and 50 μL of 1M DTT.

Make Complete Minimum Essential Medium (CMEM) comprising Minimum Essential Medium Joklik’s Modified with 5% Fetal Bovine Serum, 1% Antibiotic Antimycotic solution, 1% L-Glutamine, and 0.05 mg/ml Gentamicin.
Set water bath/stir plate unit to 35°C for cell preparation.
Count murine L929 cells and pellet 4 x 10^6 cells per 50 ml tube (2 tubes) at 215 x g, for 10 min in table top centrifuge.
Re-suspend one cell pellet in 1 mL of CMEM as the Mock.
Re-suspend the other cell pellet in 1 mL DMEM media for infection.
Dilute 10 µl purified virus in 90 µl PBS to achieve a multiplicity of infection of 10.
Bind virus to cells for 1 hour, mixing gently every 12 minutes.
Add a stir bar and 150 mL CMEM to each of the two culture flasks.
After 1 hour binding, add infected cells to their designated bottles.
Pellet cells at 1400 x g for 10 minutes in a Sorval centrifuge.
Resuspend pellets in PBS containing 0.01% BSA and place on ice.
Perform two additional washes followed by centrifugation at 1200 rpm for 8 min.
Resuspend cells in the same buffer at a final concentration of 300,000 cells/mL.
Wash cells three times with PBS containing 0.01% BSA.
Centrifuge cells at 1500 rpm for 5 minutes after each wash.
Resuspend cells in the same buffer after washing.
Filter cell suspension through a 40 μm filter.
Resuspend filtered cells to a final concentration of 120,000 cells/mL.
Pellet cells by centrifugation based on the type of cells.
Wash pellet twice with cold PBS containing 0.01% BSA.
Add 1 mL of lysis buffer to the cell pellet.
Incubate lysate at 4°C for 15 min with occasional vortexing.
Centrifuge lysate at 4°C for 14000 rpm for 15 min.
Take supernatant and add it to hybridize to beads with gentle rolling at room temperature for 15 min.
Wash beads once with TE-SDS.
Wash beads twice with TE-TW.
Load the cell and barcoded bead suspension into 3 mL syringes.
Connect the syringes to the microfluidic chip via 26G1/2 sterile needles and PE2 tubing.
Place the bead syringe upside down on the syringe pump, along with a flea magnet inside for constant stirring using an external magnetic stirrer.
Flow both bead and nuclei suspensions at 4000 uL/hr each.
Load carrier oil in 10 mL syringes and flow it at 15 mL/hr to co-encapsulate cells and beads in droplets.
Collect resulting emulsion via PE2 tubing into a 50 mL Falcon tube.
Carefully remove excess clear oil from emulsion collected after microfluidic co-encapsulation.
Add 30 mL of 6x SSC to each 50 mL Falcon collection tube.
Add 1 mL of 1H,1H,2H,2H-Perfluorooctan-1-ol to the mixture and shake vigorously up and down 4-5 times.
Centrifuge falcon tube at 1,000 x g for 1 min.
Carefully remove supernatant from each tube.
Pipette an additional 30 mL of 6x SSC to kick up beads from oil-water interface into aqueous phase.
Transfer beads that were kicked up immediately into the SSC with a 25 mL pipette into a clean 50 mL Falcon tube, leaving heavier oil behind.
Centrifuge newly transferred beads and SSC mix again at 1,000 x g for 1 min.
Carefully remove supernatant leaving ~1 mL of SSC and bead sediment behind.
Transfer remaining SSC and bead mix into a 1.5 mL micro-centrifuge tube.
Spin the micro-centrifuge tube down on a desktop micro-centrifuge for ~10 sec to generate a noticeable bead pellet.
Remove any residual oil that got transferred into the 1.5 mL tube with a p200 pipette using a low-retention pipette tip.
Wash the beads in 1.5 mL of 6x SSC.
Wash the beads again in 300 μl of 5x Maxima H-RT buffer.
Make a fresh batch of 200 µl RT mix for each barcoded bead aliquot.
Remove the supernatant from each bead pellet carefully.
Add 200 µl of the RT mix into each tube.
Incubate in a thermal mixer at 1600 rpm for 30 min at room temperature.
Incubate at 45°C for 2 hr.
Post RT, wash bead pellet with 1 mL of TE buffer containing 0.5% SDS once.
Wash the beads twice with 1 mL of TE buffer containing 0.01% Tween-20.
Wash the beads once with 1 mL of 10 mM Tris pH 8.0.
Spin down to remove all supernatant.
Treat the beads with exonuclease I.
Add 20 µl of Exo I buffer, 170 µl of RNAse free water, and 10 µl of Exo I enzyme to each tube.
Mix well by pipetting up and down.
Incubate for 45 min at 37°C in a thermal mixer at 1600 rpm.
Wash the pellet with TE-SDS and TE-TW washes.
Wash the pellet in 1 mL of RNAse free water.
Count beads and resuspend aliquots of 2,000 beads in a PCR mix consisting of 24.6 µl H2O, 0.4 µl SMART PCR primer, and 25 µl Kapa HiFi Hotstart Readymix.
Amplify the samples with initial denaturation at 95°C for 3 min.
Cycle through 4 cycles of 98°C for 20 sec, 65°C for 45 sec, 72°C for 3 min.
Cycle through 11 cycles of 98°C for 20 sec, 67°C for 20 sec, 72°C for 3 min.
Final extension at 72°C for 5 min.
Transfer PCR reactions into 1.5 ml Eppendorf tubes.
Clean PCR reactions with 0.6X SPRI beads.
Quantify purified cDNA using Qubit dsDNA HS Assay kit and BioAnalyzer High Sensitivity Chip.
Use 600 pg of each sample library for fragmentation, tagging, and amplification according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Quantify Nextera libraries again with Qubit dsDNA HS Assay kit and BioAnalyzer High Sensitivity Chip.
Use 0.1 ng DNA from cDNA library for each qPCR reaction.
Mix 1 μL cDNA (0.1 ng/μL), 10 μL of iTaq™ Universal SYBR® Green Supermix (Bio-Rad), 0.5 μL of forward primer (10 μM), 0.5 μL of reverse primer (10 μM) and 13 μL of DNAse, RNAse free water.

Perform reactions in a sealed 96-well plate using the following program (Bio-Rad C1000 Touch Thermal Cycler): 95 °C for 10 minutes; 95 °C for 30 seconds; 65 °C for 1 minute; plate read in SYBR channel; repeat steps (2)-(4) 49 tcycles; 12 °C infinite hold.
Incubate the beads for 45 minutes at 46 ˚C in an Eppendorf ThermoMixer C (15”, at 1800 RPM).
Add 6000 DART-seq beads to a mixture containing 18 uL of 5M NaCl, 2 μL of 1M Tris HCl pH 8.0, 1 μL of SDS, 78 μl of water, and 1 μL of 100 μM Cy5 fluorescently labeled oligo.
Incubate the beads for 45 minutes at 46 °C in an Eppendorf ThermoMixer C at 1800 RPM.
Wash beads with 250 μL TE-SDS.
Wash beads with 250 μL TE-TW.
Resuspend beads in water and image in the Zeiss Axio Observer Z1 in the Cy5 channel and bright field.
Add 3000 DART-seq beads to a mixture containing 18 uL of 5M NaCl, 2 μL of 1M Tris HCl pH 8.0, 1 μL of SDS, 78 μl of water, and 1 μL of 100 μM Cy5 fluorescently labeled oligo.
Incubate the mixture for 45 minutes at 46 °C in an Eppendorf ThermoMixer C at 1800 RPM.
Wash beads with 250 μL TE-SDS.
Wash beads with 250 μL TE-TW.
Resuspend beads in 200 μL water and transfer to a Qubit optical readout tube.
Set Qubit to the “Fluorometer” readout, then select the 635 nm readout channel for measurement of Cy5 probes.
Vortex Qubit tube to stir beads suspended in water and immediately place into Qubit and read the fluorescence.
Perform measurement two more times per condition.
